body:
## What

Lands the F&O 4.0 §17.6 element↔map conversion cluster at the frozen `XPath40` level (not experimental), plus the PR2688 map path navigation engine companion. qt4tests gate gains three sets → **210**.

- **`fn:element-to-map`** — layout inference (empty/simple/list/record/sequence/mixed + `-plus` variants, union-merged over same-named elements per §14.6.2), `@`-prefixed attribute keys, text under `#content`, `name-format` default/eqname, plan-driven typing with numeric subtype promotion (all-int → `xs:integer`, int+decimal mix → `xs:decimal`, any exponent → `xs:double`), FOJS0008 on plan-layout violations, FOJS0010 liberal mode.
- **`fn:map-to-element`** — rebuilds a parentless element from a single-entry map (FOJS0009 on malformed input, XPTY0004 on non-map).
- **`fn:element-to-map-plan`** / **`fn:jvalue`** — plan extraction and typed-value unwrap.
- **Engine (PR2688)**: a string literal in non-first step position is a lookup step (`$m/"key"`, `$m//"key"` descendant closure, `$m//QName` name-test-as-key). The `firstStep` parser disambiguation fixes a live XPDY0002 regression where string-literal primaries (e.g. `parse-xml('<a/>')` arguments) were parsed as lookup steps.
- **Harness**: recursive predefined-entity decode convention (test expressions + string-valued asserts decoded a second time; `assert-xml` stays single-expanded) — required by map-to-element-014/021 without regressing fn-iri-to-uri-18A / string-template-004.
- **`MayContainMaps` scans only `MaterializedSequence`** — lazy streams stay single-enumeration (StreamingXPathTests.ReverseAxisInsideRecord).

## Verification

- `dotnet test Bosak.sln -c Release`: all green, **3,477 passed / 0 failed** (Standard.Tests 1,193/0 incl. new ElementMapTests 22/0; VersionGateTests 156/0).
- QT3 gate: **31,142/0/679**, exit 0.
- XSLT smoke (`catalog.xml mode`): **162/0/26**.
- qt4tests per-set: fn-element-to-map **174/0/40**, fn-map-to-element **156/0/2**, fn-element-to-map-plan **20/0/1**.
- qt4tests gate-only (`BOSAK_QT4_GATE_ONLY=1`) with the final binary: **7,503/0/1,832, exit 0, 210 gated sets**.
title: REQ-123 element-to-map slice: fn:element-to-map / fn:map-to-element / fn:element-to-map-plan / fn:jvalue (F&O 4.0 §17.6, frozen level) + PR2688 map path navigation
